cohort: The study included 359 consecutive women who underwent robotically assisted sacrocolpopexy (RASCP) for stage III-IV pelvic organ prolapse (POP).
finding: Optimal experience levels for surgical team members in RASCP (surgeon 44, first assistant 13, surgical technologist 66, circulating nurse 56, anesthesia provider 46 robotic procedures) were identified, with surgical technologists and first assistants playing the most significant roles in influencing OR time.
